title: Verify Handoff Package
description: Post-publication content check: lists gs://<bucket>/<storage_key>/ and fails (INCOMPLETE) if any required manifest, README or failure table is missing, or any file is 0 bytes, placeholder-only, or invalid JSON. A failed listing is VERIFY_FAILED, never an empty bucket.

bucket.description: Optional GCS bucket override (else identity.bucket or $HANDOFF_BUCKET; no default)
